name: Forensix — DFIR mission conformity checklist import
description: Imports a filled-in Forensix DFIR mission workbook (Excel) into XORCISM's CERT/Forensics module (/cert-ops). Forensix is a digital-forensics / incident-response mission checklist: 85 controls across 6 phases (methodology & legal framework, disk acquisition, network PCAP, memory & live forensics, correlation & report, logs & SIEM), each with a status (compliant / non-compliant / in-progress / to-verify) and a normative reference (ISO/IEC 27037, RFC 3227, French CPP, GDPR/RGPD, Code penal, NIS2, ANSSI, MITRE ATT&CK). XORCISM replicates this natively as the per-case forensic conformity checklist; this connector reads each phase sheet's control statuses (a stdlib-only .xlsx reader — no openpyxl), positions them onto the bundled English control catalogue, and imports them as a FORENSICCASE + its FORENSICCHECK rows (runner.import_forensic_checklist), so the case shows its per-phase and overall methodology conformity. Offline only (no secrets): pass `file` = the filled Forensix .xlsx (or a JSON export {case, checks}), or run with no file for the bundled sample.

parameters.name: file
parameters.help: The filled Forensix .xlsx (or a JSON export of the checklist statuses)

parameters.name: name
parameters.help: Forensic case title (defaults to 'Forensix DFIR mission')
